description: Source code implementing hash-based comparison for text and binary data chunks, used for diffing in version control. Contains functions for hashing, rehashing, and counting changes between file versions.

methods.name: spanhash_rehash
methods.description: Rehashes the hash table when it becomes too full, doubling its size.

methods.name: add_spanhash
methods.description: Adds a hash value and count to the hash table, rehashing if necessary.

methods.name: spanhash_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting hash entries by hash value and count.

methods.name: hash_chars
methods.description: Computes hash buckets for a file's data, distinguishing text and binary files.
